## Library Clusters {#extension-areas .section-title}

```{=html}
<div class="wh-book-grid wh-reveal">
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Observation</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="../advanced-remote-sensing/">Remote Sensing Library</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Orbits, GPS, sensing geometry, radar, LiDAR, thermal methods, gravity, and retrieval logic form a coherent observation branch.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Cold Systems</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="../cryosphere-and-mountain-systems/">Cryosphere and Mountain Systems</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Snow, glaciers, permafrost, alpine hydrology, and mountain hazards form a distinct field-focused branch of the project.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Human Systems</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="../economic-systems/">Economic Geography and Infrastructure</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Trade, transport, pipelines, pricing, and energy systems belong together as a strong human-systems branch beyond the gateway chapters in the core book.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Methods</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="../machine-learning/">Machine Learning and Inference</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Open these later, once the logic of modelling, uncertainty, and spatial analysis already feels familiar.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Observation Support</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="../environmental-systems/">Orbits, GPS, and Sensing Geometry</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Some Earth observation foundations still live inside Environmental Systems for now, but they function as part of the wider remote sensing library.</div>
  </article>
</div>
```
